phase_contract.phase_start_step: active entries strictly increasing multiples of 24; first is 0
phase_contract.land_start_step: [batch, 6]; purchase window only, never derives land target

nonredundancy_decisions.crop_start_step: not a gene; represented by phase start plus target transition 0 to positive
nonredundancy_decisions.crop_lot_size: not a gene; project deficit comes from target minus active, dispatch size comes from plant_wave_size
nonredundancy_decisions.deposit_inventory_fraction: not a gene; unit inventory has no fixed capacity denominator
nonredundancy_decisions.sell_cash_trigger: not a gene; cash forcing uses cash_floor plus committed cost
nonredundancy_decisions.sell_max_quantity: not a gene; sell_fraction is the only normal quantity control
nonredundancy_decisions.primary_support_crop: forbidden in M2.6; historical M2.5 only
